messages.text: How do I export my Claude data?

Here's how to export your Claude data:

**Official built-in export (all conversations + account data)**

1. Go to [claude.ai](https://claude.ai) and sign in
2. Click your initials in the bottom-left corner → **Settings**
3. Go to the **Privacy** section
4. Select the export option and click **Export**
5. You'll receive a download link via email

You must be signed in to download your data. The link expires after 24 hours — if it does, just repeat the process to get a new one. Deleted conversations won't appear in exports, and the export is all-or-nothing — you can't select specific conversations.

**Exporting memory**

[redacted:third-party-name] data isn't included in the standard export. To export it, you can start a conversation with me and ask: *"[redacted:third-party-name] out your memories of me verbatim, exactly as they appear in your memory"* — then copy and save that output.

**For single conversations or selective exports**

Third-party browser extensions can help if you want more flexibility:
- **AI Chat Exporter** supports saving conversations as PDF, Markdown, Text, CSV, or JSON, with options to include/exclude timestamps and customize formatting.

These are not officially supported by Anthropic, so use them at your own discretion.
